name: week
title: Litigation review
subtitle: Internal working record. Review before relying on it.

sections.title: Chronology
sections.sql: select matter,code,occurred_on,date_precision,fact,current_support,stale_citations,conflicts from v_chronology order by matter,occurred_on nulls last,code

sections.title: Attention
sections.sql: select m.code as matter,a.code,a.owner,a.finding from v_attention a join matters m on m.id=a.matter_id order by matter,finding,code

sections.title: Evidence coverage
sections.sql: select m.code as matter,i.code,i.issue,i.facts,i.reviewed_supported,i.contested from v_issue_proof i join matters m on m.id=i.matter_id order by matter,i.code

sections.title: Review prompts
sections.sql: select m.code as matter,c.code,c.rule,c.finding,c.source from v_compliance c join matters m on m.id=c.matter_id order by matter,rule
